title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
summary: NPR's Planet Money examines San Francisco's dramatic drop in car thefts and break-ins since 2022 and asks how much credit Flock's AI-powered license plate reader network deserves, citing one preliminary study finding an 11% drop in car thefts in Flock-adopting agencies. The piece also details SFPD's data-sharing breaches — including 1.6 million illegal out-of-state searches and 299 improper searches tied to federal agencies — and Mayor Lurie's new 30-day retention rule plus DA Jenkins's push for state legislation criminalizing misuse.

key_quotes.quote: deploying Flock cameras was associated with an 11% drop in car thefts in the first year.
